inverness_boutique_keeper.text: Hello and welcome. The Highlands in one shop, and fewer midges.

then.text: Is that your {worn_coat}? Well, it'll do on the Moray Firth in February.
That {worn_hat} would be at home on the A9 or in a ceilidh.
That {worn_top} is a good base. A kilt would top it, mind.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: You look like you're passing through. Stay a minute.

inverness_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
